messages:
Ava: Okay team random idea — 7-day Desk Plank + Sit-to-Stand streak? 90s plank once a day + 10 standing reps at your desk. Who's in? :muscle: 
Diego: In. Morning or afternoon?
Ava: Either works. I vote morning to kickstart the day. Also small prize: bragging rights + coffee for the champion ☕️
Priya: I'll join but 90s is brutal. can we do 60s for day 1?
Ava: Flexible — scaled version ok. goal is consistency not pain. :thumbsup:
Devon: @Ava can streak-bot track? we did a water challenge before.
streak-bot: streak-bot: To log, DM me 'plank done' or use `/remind #random every weekday at 9am "Log your plank"`
Sam: I can set a shared spreadsheet if people prefer — I'll post link
Sam: Spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/desk-plank (mock link)
Priya: I made a tiny slack emoji for this: :plank-pose: can someone add it?
Diego: :eyes: also we should decide how to handle travel days
Ava: travel = 30s hold counts. no excuses :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Devon: deal. first check-in Monday 9:15am? quick thread to post 'done' and optionally time
Priya: sounds good. i'm pumped. let's do a mini 'stand-up' every day at 9:05 for 2 mins
Ava: Love it. @streak-bot set reminder please
streak-bot: streak-bot: Reminder set for weekdays 9:05. Good luck! :trophy:
Devon: :muscle: see y'all Monday
